basic_info.description: Experience the perfect blend of vintage elegance and modern luxury in this chic and spacious top-floor, light-filled 3-bedroom, 2-bath Edwardian flat nestled in San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhood: the Nob Hill Polk Street corridor. This exquisite residence offers an open-concept living area seamlessly connected to a sun-drenched, private deck, ideal for entertaining and relaxation. The chef's kitchen features top-of-the-line Viking appliances, including a six-burner gas stove, wine fridge, dishwasher, microwave, and bottom freezer fridge. The primary suite boasts two large closets and a luxurious bathroom with dual sinks, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. The large second bedroom with bay windows and the third bedroom with a walk-in closet provide versatile space. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, a second full bath, convenient one-car parking, and Sonic Fiber Internet connection making this meticulously appointed TIC flat a truly exceptional place to call home.
